## Goal
`docs/i18n/STRINGS.md` cites `src/freemyid/wizard/views.py` once and never cites `report.py`, `protect.py`, `tray.py`, `desktop.py` or `firstrun.py`. `docs/i18n/STRINGS_CLI.md` (WO-232, in review) covers CLI output.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. A new inventory in the same table format as STRINGS.md (Source | Visible string(s) | Context | Plural / variable notes) with `path:line` citations, for user-visible fixed English in `src/freemyid/wizard/views.py`, `report.py`, `protect.py`, `tray.py` (menu labels 38-44), `desktop.py` (window titles, splash and error text) and `firstrun.py` (37-38).
2. No row repeats one already in STRINGS.md or STRINGS_CLI.md; the file links to both.
3. Placeholders are written as `{name}`, never example personal values; consent, legal and security copy is flagged "owner review before translation".
4. The file says plainly that no Spanish interface ships yet.

Plain English for developers; every claim about the code carries an inline `path:line` citation in the format `tests/codex/test_cx_dev_source_citations.py` parses. Describe what the code does today; anything unreleased is "coming". No key, cipher or secret-handling details (in-house only, docs/VENDOR.md). No real personal data. Offline: no network, no git, no installs.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)

- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

`src/` (read only), `docs/dev/ARCHITECTURE.md` (WO-230 is in review; link to it, don't edit it), every other docs file, `web/`, Grok's lane, in-house paths.

- Every citation in the new file checked by hand against the worktree source; list the count in VENDOR_STATUS.md (WO-255 adds the file to the automatic guard).
